setup.title: Use this iPhone as your webcam
setup.subtitle: PairCam needs two permissions. Video goes straight to your computer and nowhere else.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: To capture the video your computer uses as a webcam.

localNetwork.title: Local Network
localNetwork.body: So PairCam on your computer can find this iPhone on your Wi-Fi.

cameraDenied.title: Camera access is off
cameraDenied.body: PairCam can't show or send video without the camera. Turn on Camera for PairCam in Settings.

cameraRestricted.title: Camera is restricted
cameraRestricted.body: This iPhone doesn't let apps use the camera. Check Screen Time or your device management settings.

localNetworkDenied.title: Local Network access is off
localNetworkDenied.body: Your computer can't find this iPhone. Turn on Local Network for PairCam in Settings.

ready.hint: Open PairCam on your PC. This iPhone appears there on its own.

noWifi.title: No Wi-Fi
noWifi.body: Connect this iPhone to the same Wi-Fi network as your computer.

cameraInterrupted.title: Camera paused
cameraInterrupted.body: Something else is using the camera. Video resumes when it's free.

connectionLost.title: Connection lost
connectionLost.body: Lost the connection to {{host}}. It reconnects on its own when it's back.

pairingTimedOut.title: Pairing timed out
pairingTimedOut.body: The request from {{host}} wasn't answered. Start pairing again from your computer.

pairing.title: Pair with {{host}}?
pairing.body: Allow only if this code matches the one on your computer.

connected.title: Connected to {{host}}
connected.hint: Video starts when you turn the camera on from your computer.

pairedComputers.title: Paired computers
pairedComputers.empty: No paired computers yet. Start pairing from PairCam on your PC.
pairedComputers.footer: Paired computers reconnect on their own, without a code.
pairedComputers.forgetBody: This computer will have to pair again before it can use this iPhone.

handsFree.title: Hands-free
handsFree.faceTrackingHint: Your computer keeps you centred in the picture.
handsFree.gesturesHint: Control the camera with the gestures below.
handsFree.footer: Both start with every session. Your computer can turn them on or off too.

palm.title: Open palm
palm.body: In Cinematic mode, hold an open hand up for a second to move the focus to it. Do it again to give the focus back.

frame.title: L shape
frame.body: Hold your thumb and index finger in an L for a second to zoom in.

cross.title: X shape
cross.body: Cross your two index fingers in an X for a second to zoom out.

spread.title: Two hands
spread.body: Move two open hands apart to zoom in, or together to zoom out.

language.title: Language
language.footer: PairCam follows your iPhone's language unless you choose one here.

about.title: About
about.footer: PairCam is free and open source under the MIT licence.

licences.title: Open-source licences
licences.intro: PairCam is built with these open-source packages.
